page.overview:
What is Extraterrestrial?

The extraterrestrial of unknown origin was an advanced, sentient species that was found in its downed spacecraft, with a Royal Facehugger on its face that impregnated it with a Queen Xenomorph, when it crash-landed on Earth.

The extraterrestrial's spacecraft crash-landed on Earth, in an American suburb, sometime during the 1950s. Matthew Webber and Lou Ann discovered the downed spacecraft on fire, went inside to investigate, and rescued the ship's pilot, an extraterrestrial with a Royal Facehugger attached to its face. Webber and Ann carried the life form out of the ship and brought him to Dr. Daniel Ripley, who removed the creature from its face, finding it to be dead. When the extraterrestrial life form woke in a panic, a Chestburster immediately erupted from its chest, and escaped into the forest near the suburb where it grew into a Queen.
